answer: Identity bonds decay like karst limestone to stop mass forgery. Each agent locks a 200-credit bond eroding 5 credits per epoch, like thin shale, and must top it up to stay live. A forger with 1,000 fake identities pays 200,000 credits up front plus 5,000 per epoch, while idle clones earn nothing. An honest agent pays one bond, tops up 5 credits per epoch from real fees, and reaches its zenith of trust as the bond's age proves honest service.
